newsitem.title: USA: Eurogas talks with U.S. firm on methane gas.
newsitem.headline: Eurogas talks with U.S. firm on methane gas.

text.p: Eurogas Inc, which controls major coalbed methane gas concessions in the Upper Silesian Coal basin in South Central Poland, said Tuesday it has began negotiations to supply gas from one of its concessions in Poland to a major U.S. utility.

A Eurogas spokesman declined to identify the company but said that the utility is leading a consortium of North American power companies which is planning to build a power station on a Eurogas concession in Katowice, Poland.
Eurogas released the information as it announced that its common shares were listed for trading starting March 10 on the Frankfurt and Berlin exchanges.
Eurogas also said it has began discussions with Polish Oil and Gas Co to jointly explore a large tract of "highly prospective ground in the Polish Carpathaian area of southeast Poland.
Eurogas also announced its previously disclosed agreement in principle with Texaco to develop certain coalbed methane gas deposits would be signed within the next two weeks.
